question: \(\angle AOB=100^\circ\), ray OC lies in the interior of \(\angle AOB\), and \(\angle AOC=3\angle BOC\). What is the measure of \(\angle BOC\), in degrees?
solution: Let \(\angle BOC=x\). Then \(\angle AOC=3x\), so \(x+3x=100^\circ\). Solving gives \(x=25^\circ\).

solutionMethods.explanation:
Because \(OC\) lies inside \(\angle AOB\), the two smaller angles together measure \(100^\circ\). The angle \(\angle AOC\) contains three parts of the size of \(\angle BOC\), so the whole angle contains four equal parts. Therefore
\[
\angle BOC=100^\circ\div(3+1)=25^\circ.
\]
solutionMethods.label: Divide into equal parts
